_comment: Acceptance criteria for any URL-model candidate. Declared 2026-10-29 BEFORE evaluating candidate www_neutral. Selection uses the validation split only; the locked test split is scored only for a candidate that passes every validation criterion.

criteria.url_shape_guard: must pass configs/url_shape_guard.json ceilings (all transformations) with no exemption
criteria.real_off_template_legitimate_eval: REQUIRED: false-positive rate measured on genuine, licensed, held-out legitimate URLs that are not https://www.<host>; transformed (synthetic) URLs are diagnostic only and cannot satisfy this criterion

rationale.recall: The model is the only signal for phishing that lacks heuristic findings; a recall loss above 1 pp on 15,078 validation phishing URLs (~150 URLs) is not justified by a false-positive fix that cannot be measured on real data.
rationale.real_data: No local, licensed dataset contains legitimate URLs outside https://www.<host> (0 of 134,850 in raw PhiUSIIL). Until one exists, no candidate can satisfy the last criterion, so no candidate can be promoted.

addendum_2026_10_29_b._comment: Declared BEFORE any candidate was trained on the new data and BEFORE the baseline was scored on it. Specifies the previously unquantified real_off_template_legitimate_eval criterion and adds gates; no existing criterion is changed or loosened.
addendum_2026_10_29_b.real_eval_source: Hannousse & Yahiouche 2021 (Mendeley 10.17632/c2gw7fy2j4.3, CC BY 4.0), registrable-domain-grouped held-out split
addendum_2026_10_29_b.high_risk_regression: known high-risk test URLs keep HIGH in the scan route; real-model tests unchanged
addendum_2026_10_29_b.selection_on: validation splits only (PhiUSIIL stratified_validation + Hannousse grouped validation); test splits scored once, only for a candidate that passes every validation gate
